mapper.select: SELECT p.productid, p.pnm, p.price, g.imgnm, p.title, p.qty, p.categoryid, c.categorynm, p.cont, top_p.totqty FROM ( SELECT productid, SUM(qty) AS totqty FROM p_order_items GROUP BY productid ORDER BY totqty DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY ) top_p JOIN products p ON top_p.productid = p.productid LEFT JOIN p_category c ON p.categoryid = c.categoryid LEFT JOIN p_gallery g ON p.productid = g.productid ORDER BY top_p.totqty DESC

SELECT c.categoryid, c.categorynm, SUM(oi.qty) AS ctgytotqty, ROUND( SUM(oi.qty) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(oi.qty)) OVER(), 0), 2 ) AS ctgyratio FROM users u JOIN p_order o ON u.usrno = o.usrno JOIN p_order_items oi ON o.orderid = oi.orderid JOIN products p ON oi.productid = p.productid JOIN p_category c ON p.categoryid = c.categoryid WHERE 1=1 AND u.gender = #{gender} AND u.birth BETWEEN #{syear} AND #{eyear} GROUP BY c.categoryid, c.categorynm ORDER BY ctgytotqty DESC

SELECT p.productid, p.pnm, p.price, p.categoryid, c.categorynm, g.imgnm, p.title, p.qty, p.cont FROM products p LEFT JOIN p_category c ON p.categoryid = c.categoryid LEFT JOIN p_gallery g ON p.productid = g.productid WHERE p.categoryid = #{categoryid} AND p.DELYN = 'N'
